title: compiled/lake/storage-plan.json: the warehouses, namespaces and landing prefixes a release needs (A8)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Emitted by k2gen.emit.lake (S15), compared between two releases by k2gen diff (S08), applied additively by deploy (S19; remote signing off and the namespaces from phase 002). It only ever adds: a warehouse, namespace or prefix a release stops listing is reported by diff and removed only by scripts/drop.sh. Every list is sorted.

warehouses.description: Warehouse k2 (connector products' namespaces) and one per domain (each product's <fence> and <fence>__base), sorted by name.

remoteSigningEnabled.description: Always false: engines read storage with their own keys, never a signing catalog (A8).

namespaces.description: The namespaces the warehouse holds, sorted.

landing.description: The landing bucket and each connector product's prefix in it.

prefixes.description: <domain>/<product>/ per product with a fetch-kind connector, sorted (k2gen.model.landing_prefix).

fence.description: A name with hyphens as underscores.
